chronicleSignature.description: ES256 cryptographic signature proving record authenticity

kid.description: Key identifier for the signing key

nonce.description: Unique random nonce to prevent replay

main.description: Signed player progression state. Singleton (rkey: self), overwritten via putRecord. Backend validates XP claims before signing.

createdAt.description: When the record was first created

level.description: Current player level (derived from XP table)

progressPercentage.description: Progress toward next level as decimal string

triggerSource.description: What triggered this save (level_up, session_end, visibility_hidden, periodic, card_advance)

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated

xpGainedSinceLastSign.description: XP gained since the last signed progress record (for rate validation against daily activity)

xpToNextLevel.description: XP remaining to reach next level
